name: verdandi-presentexact-confirm

provenance.tool: shell presentexact-window (shell/presentexact.rs court over the borderless 1:1 GDI window with screen readback, appended to shell/win32.rs) + verify/presentexact.py
provenance.surface: shell/presentexact.rs court over the borderless 1:1 GDI window with screen readback (DwmFlush, QPC) surface

validity_scope.certifies: the certified composite presented 1:1 by StretchDIBits and by SetDIBitsToDevice in a borderless 1920x1080 window at the screen's origin on host DANIELDILLBERG, the composed screen read back before and after the court, uninstrumented envelopes interleaved ABBA, locked phase origin, 1000 samples per cell over 4 frames (a confirmation run)

forbidden_interpretations: that the pixels reach the eye unchanged: the readback is the composed screen, before scan-out, the panel and any display-side colour processing
that the readback holds between the checked frames: it is taken on the sealed frames before the clock and on the last frame after it, not on every sample
an adoption from one run, from a comparator sealed in another run, or from the p50s
that the recorded host state explains or caused a number: HOST-STATE-0 is recorded beside and never read
input-to-photon latency, or a comparison with any emit p99
any other host, screen size, scaling setting or GPU driver

readback.method: clear to white, read the clear back, present, read the composed screen back

rule.margin: an adoption margin (a declared decision threshold), not an uncertainty

power.codes: ac_line_status 0 offline, 1 online, 255 unknown; battery_percent 255 unknown

load.source: GetSystemTimes over the window, all processors

process.of: the sealing process; the court process is its child

display.source: GetDeviceCaps on the screen DC: the nominal mode, not the court's measured refresh

thermal.unavailable: not captured: no reliable source without elevation (declared, not attempted)
